columns.label: Build tool · read_web_page
columns.doc: Propose a candidate tool of this kind. A candidate is a proposal: it enters the catalog only after tests and an admission decision.

columns.doc: Propose a candidate tool of this kind. A candidate is a proposal: it enters the catalog only after tests and an admission decision.

columns.label: Use active tools
columns.doc: Invoke a tool of the active catalog. Bounded by the network scope and the URL selection mode.

columns.label: Reach network hosts
columns.doc: Exact DNS hosts the operator's tool invocations may contact.

columns.label: Review a tested tool
columns.doc: Give an approve/refuse opinion on the exact tested digest.

columns.label: Admit a tool
columns.doc: Decide admission of the exact tested (and reviewed) candidate. Held by exactly one authority per unit (admissionMode).

columns.label: Activate an admitted tool
columns.doc: Reserved to the host mechanism that owns the catalog; no operator mandate may hold it (compile-time refusal).

columns.label: Widen network scope
columns.doc: Operators propose this exact change; a human decision applies it. The model policy must allow it.

columns.label: Change URL selection
columns.doc: Operators propose this exact change; a human decision applies it. The model policy must allow it.

columns.label: Delegate own admission
columns.doc: Operators propose this exact change; a human decision applies it. The model policy must allow it.

columns.label: Create a reviewer
columns.doc: Propose an independent reviewer with the exact review+admit mandate.

columns.label: Rewrite own mandate directly
columns.doc: mayChangeOwnMandate: always false (compile-time refusal).

columns.label: Create operators directly
columns.doc: mayCreateAgents: always false (compile-time refusal).

columns.label: Read the model sources
columns.doc: Read model sources and selective model context. Unlocked by the same flag as source proposals (mayProposeSysmlRevision).

columns.label: Propose model edits
columns.doc: Propose source edits inside the (file, qualified roots) ceiling and the listed operations. Proposals are private until decided.

columns.label: Delegate edit rights
columns.doc: Grant or revoke bounded model-edit rights to exact recipient systems (delegation ledger).

columns.label: Accept a model revision
columns.doc: Accept or refuse a proposed source revision. Owner HTTP path only.

columns.label: Adopt a model version
columns.doc: Make an accepted version the executable one. Owner HTTP path only.

columns.label: Read evidence
columns.doc: Call a native action exposed to this operator by a BehaviorAccess (caller, target, enabled). Allocation alone grants nothing.

uncertain.reason: compileBehaviorCatalog drops disabled exposures; read back from the typed Toolkit graph (BehaviorAccess.enabled = false)

diagnostics.recovery: expose memory-review to a second operator of the same memory owner, or set allowSelfAdmission
authority lot 1 models the owner (HumanOperator + RootAuthority + RootGrant); until then owner cells are host rules, not declarations

caveats: ALLOWED_IS_DECLARED_NOT_EXECUTED: a cell states declared authority; execution still passes the host checks at call time (digest, catalog revision, executor registration: src/application/behavior-call-admission.ts:57-66).
ABSENT_CELL_IS_NOT_APPLICABLE: a missing (row, column) pair means no declaration or host rule concerns that pair.
OWNER_CELLS_ARE_HOST_RULES_BEFORE_LOT_3: the owner is not a declared operator in main; its cells cite the TS enforcement point.
ADOPTED_VERSION_ONLY: the matrix describes the compiled source version, not pending proposals.
